public_rationale: There is evidence of slower growth in relevant investment measures and a smaller GDP contribution from broad investment categories. That does not establish the forecast's specific NVIDIA GPU channel. No decisive event found settles the complete sequence. Because Zitron gave no deadline, continued investment or an incomplete slowdown episode cannot by itself falsify the forecast.
limitations: Slower growth and lower absolute spending are different tests.
Broad infrastructure spending and data-center revenue are imperfect proxies for NVIDIA GPU purchases.
An accounting contribution to GDP does not alone establish the claimed causal mechanism.

statement.excerpt: At some point capex has to slow — if not because of the lack of revenues or massive costs associated, but because we live in a world with finite space, and when said capex slow happens, so will purchases of NVIDIA GPUs, which will in turn, as proven by Kedrosky and others, slow America’s economic growth.

from_speaker: At some point capex has to slow
when said capex slow happens, so will purchases of NVIDIA GPUs
our_interpretation: This predicts an eventual sequence: slower AI capital expenditure, slower NVIDIA GPU purchasing because of that change, and lower US growth because of the purchasing slowdown.
The plain reading of slow includes a lower growth rate; expenditure need not fall in absolute dollars. The later reference to a reduction creates an alternative reading.
The main spending group is Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta, with broader AI infrastructure spending relevant to the aggregate claim.
US growth must be lower than it otherwise would have been; an outright recession is not required.
No deadline is supplied. At some point does not create one.
The speaker does not supply an accounting basis for the projected expenditure sequence.
criteria.support_condition: A dated slowdown in consistently measured AI capex is shown to reduce NVIDIA GPU purchasing growth, with credible evidence that this channel lowers US economic growth.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A completed, adequately observed slowdown episode provides credible evidence against the asserted causal sequence. Continued spending growth before an unspecified future date does not contradict the eventual forecast.
